title: Development and Application of a Novel Machine Learning Model Predicting Pancreatic Cancer-Specific Mortality
summary: Survival Quilts predicts postoperative pancreatic-cancer mortality in a SEER cohort and improves short-term discrimination versus Cox, with internal test validation only.
